fact: The first human to orbit Earth was Yuri Gagarin in 1961.
The Apollo 11 mission landed the first humans on the Moon in 1969.
The Hubble Space Telescope was launched in 1990 and has helped astronomers study the universe.
Mars has been explored by robotic orbiters, landers and rovers.
The International Space Station has supported continuous human presence since November 2000.
Voyager 1 was launched in 1977 and is the most distant human-made spacecraft.
SpaceX was founded in 2002 and develops reusable rockets and spacecraft.
The James Webb Space Telescope launched in December 2021 and observes the universe in infrared.
The Milky Way galaxy contains hundreds of billions of stars.
Black holes are regions of spacetime where gravity is so strong that light cannot escape from within the event horizon.
